channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli attacks on Lebanon continue after Trump saying they’d stop
item.description: Israeli air strikes on southern Lebanon have continued, a day after US President said the ‘shooting’ would stop

item.title: UK Athletics fined over death of UAE Paralympian Abdullah Hayayei
item.description: Abdullah Hayayei was killed in London in 2017 while preparing for the World ​Para Athletics Championships.

item.title: Trump says Israel, Hezbollah to stop fighting: What we know
item.description: Netanyahu agrees to halt operations near Beirut; Hezbollah to stop attacks on Israel under new truce arrangement.

item.title: Refugee women in CAR face childbirth risks amid US funding cuts
item.description: Limited staffing and supplies force pregnant women in CAR to give birth at home, increasing risks of preventable deaths.

item.title: How the war has made Iran’s water crisis worse
item.description: Attacks on desalination plants and other water infrastructure by US and Israel have further added to the water woes.

item.title: Ukraine rescuers pull dead from rubble after Russian strikes kill 22 people
item.description: An eight-year-old boy killed in a strike on an apartment block are among the dead, officials say.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
item.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

item.title: British couple lose Iran jail sentence appeal, family says
item.description: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were arrested in January 2025 during a global motorbike journey.

item.title: South Africa police investigate killing of two Mozambican men
item.description: The deaths come after a day of violent protests against illegal migration in the town of Mossel Bay.

item.title: Missing lab worker found dead in New Mexico nearly a year after disappearing
item.description: Melissa Casias' case was part of debunked speculations about recent deaths and disappearances in the US scientific community.
